description: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Public Data API — time-series for CPI, employment, unemployment, JOLTS, productivity, and more.

tools.name: series_batch
tools.description: Fetch up to 50 BLS series in one call. Pass --ids comma-separated; the CLI partitions IDs >50 across multiple requests. Required: ids. Optional: start, end, latest (plus 4 more). Returns the new TimeSeriesResponse.

params.name: ids
params.description: List of packed BLS series IDs (JSON array or comma-separated, e.g. 'CUUR0000SA0,LNS14000000').

params.name: latest
params.description: Return only the latest observation per series.

params.name: calculations
params.description: Add YoY/MoM percent-change columns (registered key only).

params.name: catalog
params.description: Include catalog metadata per series (registered key only).

tools.name: series_get
tools.description: Fetch a single BLS time-series by ID. Required: seriesid. Optional: start, end, latest (plus 4 more). Returns the TimeSeriesResponse.

params.name: seriesid
params.description: Packed BLS series ID, e.g. CUUR0000SA0 (CPI-U all items) or LNS14000000 (U.S. unemployment rate).

params.name: start
params.description: Earliest year to include (default: 10 most recent years for the unauth tier, 20 with a key).

params.name: latest
params.description: Return only the latest observation. Pairs with startyear/endyear when set.

params.name: calc
params.description: Add server-side YoY/MoM percent-change columns (requires a registered key).

params.name: annual-avg
params.description: Include annual averages alongside monthly values (requires a registered key).

params.name: catalog
params.description: Include catalog metadata (title, units, survey) per series (requires a registered key).

params.name: aspects
params.description: Include aspect-level metadata (e.g. CPI item codes) per observation.

tools.name: series_popular
tools.description: List BLS's most-popular series, optionally filtered by survey. Optional: survey. Returns the PopularResponse.

params.name: survey
params.description: Survey abbreviation (e.g. CU for CPI-U, LN for CPS, JT for JOLTS). Omit for the all-survey popular list.

tools.name: surveys_get
tools.description: Show detail for a single BLS survey (allowed calculations, annual averages, etc.). Required: survey_abbreviation. Returns the SurveysListResponse.

params.name: survey_abbreviation
params.description: Two-letter survey abbreviation, e.g. CU, LN, CE, JT, PP, EC, PR.

tools.name: surveys_list
tools.description: List every BLS survey by abbreviation and name. Returns the SurveysListResponse.
